title: Poundland collapses into administration, putting 12,000 jobs at risk
summary_full: US owner Gordon Brothers rejected at least two last-ditch bids for UK budget retailerDo you work for Poundland? Tell us how you’re affectedPoundland has called in administrators, putting 12,000 jobs at risk in the run-up to Christmas after its owners rejected at least two last-ditch bids for the budget retailer.Administrators at AlixPartners have been appointed to the retailer, which has 600 stores in the UK and Ireland, by Poundland’s directors. The chain is now expected to be broken up with significant job losses and store closures. Continue reading...
